title: The marketing site serves chattic.us from its own deployment

comments.author: home
comments.text:
As a visitor, I want chattic.us to load the marketing site from its own
deployment, so that marketing changes ship independently of the product.

**Blocked by:** nothing. **Unblocks:** S2 (DNS cutover), S3.

---
Feature: Marketing site deployment

  Scenario: The marketing distribution serves the home page
    Given the Chattic.us-web repository's CDK stack deployed to production
    When a browser requests https://chattic.us/
    Then the response is the marketing home page rendered from the new deployment

  Scenario: Feature, contact, and waitlist pages are reachable
    Given the marketing distribution is live
    When a browser requests /features/approvals, /contact/services, and /waitlist/confirm
    Then each renders its migrated page content

**Done when:** the scenarios pass against the marketing distribution's own
CloudFront domain, before DNS cutover.
